# Data Extraction

RRF reference data are sourced from the US FDA Chemicals List for Analytical Performance (CLAP) — <https://cdrh-rst.fda.gov/chemicals-list-analytical-performance-clap>. Three datasets (GC/MS, LC/MS positive-ion, LC/MS negative-ion) were extracted from the corresponding PDFs and stored as Excel workbooks. Non-detected values were set to 0 and values reported as below the detection limit were set to 0.001, following Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance. All three datasets are loaded in every simulation file to maintain cross-technique comparability; only the dataset relevant to this scenario is sampled in the Monte Carlo loop.

```{r}
#| message: false
# ── GC/MS RRF data (CLAP) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Source: RRF GCMS for CLAP.pdf  →  ../../data/processed/CLAP_GCMS_clean.xlsx  (sheet "GC-MS")
gcms_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_GCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "GC-MS")
gcms_clap_clean <- gcms_clap %>% na.omit()
gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"  <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL")

# ── LC/MS positive-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Positive Ion Detection.pdf  →  ../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap_clean <- lcmspos_clap %>% na.omit()

# ── LC/MS negative-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Negative Ion Detection.pdf  →  ../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap_clean <- lcmsneg_clap %>% na.omit()

# Dataset size check
# Each simulation iteration draws N_extractables = 80 compounds WITHOUT replacement;
# the relevant column must contain at least 80 non-missing entries.
cat(sprintf("GC/MS:   %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(gcms_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS+:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmspos_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS-:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmsneg_clap_clean)))
```

# Simulation parameters

```{r}
# Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) in µg/mL
AET <- 3
```

## Fitted RRF distribution (censored MLE)

The gamma distribution parameters below are estimated by **censored maximum likelihood** (via `fitdistcens`) from the CLAP LC/MS+ RRF data at the 20 µg/mL surrogate concentration, consistent with the approach in `RRFdistcens.qmd`. Non-detected values (stored as 0) and below-DL values (stored as 0.001) are treated as left-censored at LOQ = 0.001 rather than dropped or substituted, which avoids biasing the shape parameter downward.

```{r}
# ── Censored MLE fit of the CLAP LC/MS+ RRF data (20 µg/mL) ─────────
#   Detected  →  left = right = observed value   (exact observation)
#   N.D./BDL  →  left = NA,   right = LOQ        (left-censored)
rrf_raw  <- as.numeric(lcmspos_clap$"20 µg/mL")
loq_rrf  <- 0.001

rrf_cens <- data.frame(
  left  = ifelse(rrf_raw <= loq_rrf, NA,      rrf_raw),
  right = ifelse(rrf_raw <= loq_rrf, loq_rrf, rrf_raw)
)

set.seed(123)
fit_rrf_gamma <- fitdistcens(rrf_cens, "gamma")
gamma_shape   <- fit_rrf_gamma$estimate["shape"]
gamma_rate    <- fit_rrf_gamma$estimate["rate"]
cat(sprintf("Fitted gamma (censored MLE):  shape = %.4f,  rate = %.4f\n",
            gamma_shape, gamma_rate))
```

# Scenario: Uniform Distribution ($U[0.4\cdot\text{AET},\ 1.4\cdot\text{AET}]$, 40% ≥ AET) with Empirical LC/MS (positive ion) RRFs (20 µg/mL Surrogate)

This notebook presents Monte Carlo simulation results quantifying the classification bias introduced by Relative Response Factors (RRFs) in LC/MS (positive ion) extractables and leachables (E&L) studies. In each iteration, 80 hypothetical extractable compounds are drawn from a chosen concentration distribution, their measured concentrations are distorted by an RRF, and each compound is classified as at or above / below the Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET). Several uncertainty-factor (UF) correction strategies are then evaluated against the baseline (no correction) using standard classification metrics.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Simulation design

| Parameter | Value |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **Analytical technique** | LC/MS (positive ion) |
| **Surrogate concentration** | **20 µg/mL** |
| **Concentration distribution (Conc ID 1)** | Uniform — $X \sim U[0.4\,\text{AET},\ 1.4\,\text{AET}]$; approximately **40%** of compounds are at or above the AET. |
| **RRF distribution (RRF ID A)** | Empirical — non-parametric bootstrap (sampling without replacement) from the LC/MS positive-ion section of the US FDA CLAP list, at a surrogate concentration of **20 µg/mL**. This approach preserves the real-world dispersion of detector response factors. |
| **AET** | 0.45 µg/mL |
| **Iterations** (`N_sim`) | 10,000 |
| **Compounds per iteration** (`N_extractables`) | 80 |
| **Correction strategies** | No correction; UF = 2; UF = 4; UF = 10; UF(RSD); UF(RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD); µ/Percentile (16th); Percentile 10th; Percentile 20th; RRFlow; RRF\<1; Machine Learning |
| **Performance metrics** | FNR, FPR, F₁, F_β (β = 5) |

The UF formulas follow ISO 10993-18. The **False Negative Rate (FNR)** quantifies under-reporting risk (compounds truly ≥ AET that are missed), while the **False Positive Rate (FPR)** quantifies over-reporting.
:::

## Initialisation of the comparison table

```{r}
# Accumulates one row per correction method; populated in the loops below.
# Columns: method label, mean FNR/FPR and their binomial SDs, precision, recall,
#          F1, F-beta (beta=5) across all N_sim iterations.
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Method = character(),
  FN_Rate = numeric(),   # False Negative Rate  (proportion of truly ≥ AET missed)
  FP_Rate = numeric(),   # False Positive Rate  (proportion of truly < AET over-reported)
  FN_SD = numeric(),     # Binomial SD of FNR
  FP_SD = numeric(),     # Binomial SD of FPR
  precision = numeric(), # TP / (TP + FP)
  recall = numeric(),    # TP / (TP + FN)  — same as sensitivity / true-positive rate
  F1 = numeric(),        # Harmonic mean of precision and recall
  f_beta = numeric()    # F-beta score (beta = 5: strongly weights recall over precision)
)
# Stores the per-iteration metric distributions for violin / density plots.
all_distributions <- data.frame()
```

## Baseline: No RRF Correction

```{r}
set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0
dist_f1 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_f5 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fnr <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fpr <- numeric(N_sim)
beta <- 5

for (i in 1:N_sim) {
base_conc_sim <- runif(N_extractables, min = 0.4 * AET, max = 1.4 * AET)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
corrected_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "No Correction",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = 1
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "No Correction",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## Uncertainty-Factor (UF) Corrections — ISO 10993-18

```{r}
rsd <- function(x) {
  return(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# RSD of the filtered RRF dataset (0.05 < RRF ≤ 1) — avoids negative UF from extreme outliers
rsd_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# Mean of the filtered RRF dataset — used in the extended UF(mean·RSD) formula
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use <- x[x <= 1 & x > 0.05]
  return(mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}


set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

# ── FIX v2: pre-compute ALL UF scalars from a single dedicated RRF draw ─────
# One seeded draw → all UF scalars share the same sample; differences in
# FN/FP across methods reflect the correction strategy, not UF sampling noise.
set.seed(42)
rrf_uf_sample <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)

UF_RSD              <- 1 / (1 - rsd(rrf_uf_sample))
UF_RSD_filtered     <- 1 / (1 - rsd_filtered(rrf_uf_sample))
UF_meanRSD_filtered <- 1 / (mean_filtered(rrf_uf_sample) * (1 - rsd_filtered(rrf_uf_sample)))
UF_meanRSD          <- 1 / (mean(rrf_uf_sample, na.rm = TRUE) * (1 - rsd(rrf_uf_sample)))

UF_list <- c(
  "UF (2)"   = 2, 
  "UF (4)"   = 4,
  "UF (10)"  = 10, 
  "UF (RSD)" = UF_RSD,

  "UF (RSD filtered)" = UF_RSD_filtered,
  "UF (µRSD filtered)" = UF_meanRSD_filtered,
  "UF (µRSD)" = UF_meanRSD
)

N_extractables <- 80

for (m_name in names(UF_list)) {
  uf_val <- UF_list[[m_name]]
  total_FN <- 0
  total_FP <- 0
  total_TP <- 0
  total_TN <- 0
  
  
for (i in 1:N_sim) {
base_conc_sim <- runif(N_extractables, min = 0.4 * AET, max = 1.4 * AET)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
  
  exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
  corrected_conc <- exp_conc * uf_val 
  
  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = m_name,
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = uf_val
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = m_name,
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
}

```

## Correction Factor mean/16th percentile

```{r}
percentile <- function(x) {
  return(quantile(x, .16))
}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- lcmspos_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- RRF_LCMS_superior0[RRF_LCMS_superior0 > 0]

meanLCMS       <- mean(rrf_uf_sample)       # FIX v2: use pre-computed sample
percentileLCMS <- percentile(rrf_uf_sample) # FIX v2: use pre-computed sample
for (i in 1:N_sim) {
base_conc_sim <- runif(N_extractables, min = 0.4 * AET, max = 1.4 * AET)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)

exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * (meanLCMS / percentileLCMS)

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = uf_val
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
```

## Correction RRFlow

```{r}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- lcmspos_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL"
RRF_LCMS_superior0 <- RRF_LCMS_superior0[RRF_LCMS_superior0 > 0]

# Apply Part 18 formula for database
UF_RRFlow <- UF_RSD  # FIX v2: reuse pre-computed scalar
UF <- UF_RRFlow            # keep "UF" name used in loop body

for (i in 1:N_sim) {

base_conc_sim <- runif(N_extractables, min = 0.4 * AET, max = 1.4 * AET)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## add a normal / lognormal distribution to get a "exp" RRF with some variability e.g 30%
exp_RRF <- simulated_RRF * rnorm(n = N_extractables, 1, 0.3)
exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * UF             # corrected concentration: Exp * UF (conservative method)
condition <- (simulated_RRF < 0.5) | (simulated_RRF > 2) # RRFlow conditions rescaling factor should be focused only to those compounds which exhibits RRF< 0.5 and RRF>2 
corrected_conc[condition] <- exp_conc[condition] / exp_RRF[condition] # average value of the RRF RRFlow application in extractables amount rescaling ( The average RRF determined by the RRFlow will be used to re-calculate the amount of the corresponding compound detected in the extractables study , will assume that it is in the linearity range) 

  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "RRFlow",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = UF_RRFlow  # FIX v2: stored scalar

  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "RRFlow",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## Correction RRF\<1

```{r}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

# Apply Part 18 formula for database
UF_RRF1 <- UF_RSD  # FIX v2: reuse pre-computed scalar
UF <- UF_RRF1            # keep "UF" name used in loop body

for (i in 1:N_sim) {

base_conc_sim <- runif(N_extractables, min = 0.4 * AET, max = 1.4 * AET)
simulated_RRF <- rgamma(N_extractables, gamma_shape, gamma_rate)
## add a normal / lognormal distribution to get a "exp" RRF with some variability e.g 30%
exp_RRF <- simulated_RRF * rnorm(n = N_extractables, 1, 0.3)
exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * UF             # corrected concentration: Exp * UF (conservative method)
condition <- (simulated_RRF < 1)  # Condition only for LOW responders
corrected_conc[condition] <- exp_conc[condition] / exp_RRF[condition] # average value of the RRF RRFlow application in extractables amount rescaling ( The average RRF determined by the RRFlow will be used to re-calculate the amount of the corresponding compound detected in the extractables study , will assume that it is in the linearity range) 

  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

## Count per iteration
  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(

    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
```

# FP vs FN

```{r}
plot_data_FN_FP <- pivot_longer(all_distributions, 
                          cols = c("F5", "Percent_FN", "Percent_FP"), 
                          names_to = "Metric", 
                          values_to = "Value")

plot_data_FN_FP$Method <- factor(plot_data_FN_FP$Method, levels = method_levels)

```

```{r}
cluster_centers <- all_distributions %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarize(
    center_FP = mean(Percent_FP, na.rm = TRUE),
    center_FN = mean(Percent_FN, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(all_distributions, aes(x = Percent_FP, y = Percent_FN, color = Method)) +
  # Plot the individual simulation dots
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 1) +
  
  # Draw the 95% confidence ellipses
  stat_ellipse(linewidth = 1, linetype = 1, type = "norm", level = 0.95) +
  
  geom_label_repel(
    data = cluster_centers, 
    aes(x = center_FP, y = center_FN, label = Method), 
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    box.padding = 0.5,         # Adds "repel force" around the label itself
    point.padding = 0.5,       # Keeps the label from sitting directly on the exact center coordinate
    segment.color = "black",   # Makes the pointer line black so it stands out
    segment.size = 0.8,        # Makes the pointer line a bit thicker
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  # Clean up the labels and aesthetics
        labs(
      title = "Trade-off: False Positives vs. False Negatives",
      subtitle = paste0("10,000 iterations per Method | AET = ", AET, " µg/mL"),
      x = "False Positive Rate (%)",
      y = "False Negative Rate (%)",
      color = "Correction Method"
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # change "bottom" to "none"!
    legend.position = "none", 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# Confusion Matrices (Average over 10,000 iterations)

```{r}
# 4-column method ordering (groups: fixed-UF | RSD-UF | Percentile | RRF/ML)
method_levels_4col <- c(
  "No Correction",
  "UF (2)",
  "UF (4)",
  "UF (10)",
  "UF (RSD)",
  "UF (RSD filtered)",
  "UF (µRSD)",
  "UF (µRSD filtered)",
  "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  "Percentile 10th",
  "Percentile 20th",
  "RRFlow",
  "RRF<1",
  "Machine Learning"
)

N_sim <- 10000

# Column guide (sums over N_sim iterations):
#   is_at_and_above_threshold        = total_TP + total_FN  (all actual positives)
#   X.is_at_and_above_threshold      = total_TN + total_FP  (all actual negatives)
#   reported_at_and_above_threshold  = total_TP + total_FP  (all predicted positives)
#   recall                           = total_TP / actual_positives
cm_data <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    total_grand = is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold,
    TP = recall * is_at_and_above_threshold,
    FN = is_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    FP = reported_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    TN = X.is_at_and_above_threshold - FP,
    # Percentage of grand total
    pct_TP = round(TP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FP = round(FP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FN = round(FN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_TN = round(TN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    # Average count per simulation (out of 80 compounds)
    avg_TP = round(TP / N_sim),
    avg_FP = round(FP / N_sim),
    avg_FN = round(FN / N_sim),
    avg_TN = round(TN / N_sim)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Method, pct_TP, pct_FP, pct_FN, pct_TN,
                         avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN)

# ── Per-iteration SD from all_distributions ───────────────────────────────────
cm_sd_base <- all_distributions %>%
  left_join(
    summary_table %>%
      transmute(
        Method,
        total_grand_per_sim = (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold) / N_sim,
        actual_pos_frac     = is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_neg_frac     = X.is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_pos_per_sim  = is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim,
        actual_neg_per_sim  = X.is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim
      ),
    by = "Method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as % of grand total
    sim_pct_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_TP = actual_pos_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FN,
    sim_pct_TN = actual_neg_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FP,
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as counts (out of 80)
    sim_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_per_sim,
    sim_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_per_sim,
    sim_TP = actual_pos_per_sim - sim_FN,
    sim_TN = actual_neg_per_sim - sim_FP
  ) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarize(
    # % SDs
    sd_pct_TP = round(sd(sim_pct_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FP = round(sd(sim_pct_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FN = round(sd(sim_pct_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_TN = round(sd(sim_pct_TN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    # Count SDs
    sd_avg_TP = round(sd(sim_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FP = round(sd(sim_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FN = round(sd(sim_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_TN = round(sd(sim_TN, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

cm_tile_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text       = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"))

cm_fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("TP" = "#2E86AB", "TN" = "#2E86AB",
             "FN" = "#E84855", "FP" = "#F4A261"),
  guide = guide_legend(title = "Cell type")
)
```

# Average count per simulation WITH ± SD

```{r}
#| warning: false
# ── Integer count confusion matrix (mean ± SD counts out of 80) ───────────────
cm_long_counts_sd <- cm_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Method, avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN),
               names_to = "Cell", values_to = "Count") %>%
  left_join(
    cm_sd_base %>%
      dplyr::select(Method, sd_avg_TP, sd_avg_FP, sd_avg_FN, sd_avg_TN) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(sd_avg_TP, sd_avg_FP, sd_avg_FN, sd_avg_TN),
                   names_to = "Cell_sd", values_to = "SD") %>%
      mutate(Cell = sub("sd_avg_", "avg_", Cell_sd)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Method, Cell, SD),
    by = c("Method", "Cell")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted = case_when(Cell %in% c("avg_TP", "avg_FP") ~ "Positive",
                          TRUE ~ "Negative"),
    Actual    = case_when(Cell %in% c("avg_TP", "avg_FN") ~ "Positive",
                          TRUE ~ "Negative"),
    CellType  = toupper(sub("avg_", "", Cell)),
    Label     = paste0(Count, "±", SD),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
    Actual    = factor(Actual,    levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
  )

cm_long_counts_sd$Method <- factor(cm_long_counts_sd$Method, levels = method_levels)

# 3-column
ggplot(cm_long_counts_sd, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
            color = "white", lineheight = 0.9) +
  cm_fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 3) +
  labs(title    = "Average Count per Simulation WITH \u00b1 SD",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean \u00b1 SD counts (out of 80 compounds) over 10,000 iterations | AET = ",
                         AET, " \u00b5g/mL"),
       x = "Predicted class (reported vs AET)",
       y = "Actual class (true vs AET)") +
  cm_tile_theme

# 4-column
cm_long_counts_sd_4col <- cm_long_counts_sd
cm_long_counts_sd_4col$Method <- factor(cm_long_counts_sd_4col$Method,
                                        levels = method_levels_4col)

ggplot(cm_long_counts_sd_4col, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
            color = "white", lineheight = 0.9) +
  cm_fill_scale +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 4) +
  labs(title    = "Average Count per Simulation WITH \u00b1 SD",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean \u00b1 SD counts (out of 80 compounds) over 10,000 iterations | AET = ",
                         AET, " \u00b5g/mL"),
       x = "Predicted class (reported vs AET)",
       y = "Actual class (true vs AET)") +
  cm_tile_theme

cm_data %>% dplyr::select(Method, avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN)
```
